messages.subject: Packratting curl fails
parts:
I have a project which I attempted to packrat within RStudio Version 0.99.903.  It gets to the point of looking for a file "curl.h" and fails.  I believe curl got installed at the same time as JSONLITE whihc was installed using install.packages.  I have added the text from the failure.  I have jsonlite version 1.1 and curl 2.1.  Anyone have an idea how to resolve this?
